record.paper_title: The Critical Beta-splitting Random Tree II: Overview and Open Problems
record.original_question: Let l̄(DTCS(n)) be the total drawn length of the cladogram representation of DTCS(n), obtained by summing the vertical line lengths in the standard discrete cladogram drawing. Prove that this quantity grows on the order of n log^4 n.

evidence.quote: One feature of interest is the drawn length l̄(χ) of the cladogram representation χ of a tree, that is the sum of lengths of the vertical lines in the cladogram.
Open Problem 14 Prove that Ln grows roughly like n log4 n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the discrete critical beta-splitting random tree DTCS(n) on n ≥ 2 leaves, defined recursively as follows. Start with a root clade of size n. A clade of size m ≥ 2 is split into two sub-clades of sizes i and m − i (1 ≤ i ≤ m − 1) with probability

  q(m, i) = (1/Z_m) · 1/(i(m − i)),  where Z_m = Σ_{j=1}^{m−1} 1/(j(m − j)),

independently for distinct clades, and this branching is iterated until all clades have size 1 (the leaves). This produces a random rooted binary tree with n leaves.

Draw DTCS(n) as a standard discrete cladogram in the plane: each internal node v of subtree size s(v) is placed at vertical height s(v) (with leaves at height 1), each internal node is connected by a horizontal segment to its two children's vertical lines, and each child c of v is joined to its own node position by a vertical line of length s(v) − s(c). Let

  L_n := ℓ̄(DTCS(n))

denote the total drawn length of this cladogram, i.e. the sum of the lengths of all vertical line segments in this drawing.

Prove that L_n grows on the order of n (log n)^4; more precisely, establish that there exist positive constants c, C such that

  c · n (log n)^4 ≤ E[L_n] ≤ C · n (log n)^4

for all sufficiently large n (and, if possible, identify the precise leading-order asymptotic).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed among open problems for the critical beta-splitting random tree model. Subsequent works (2024–2025) on the model develop central limit theorems for related statistics (depth, height, leaf-counts) but no source found resolves the n log^4 n asymptotic order for the total drawn cladogram length L_n.
